question: What new service begins on March 26, 2026, in rail transport in Europe?

steps.content: [2026 in rail transport] This article lists events related to rail transport that are currently scheduled to occur in 2026. 26 March – European Sleeper begins a night train service between Paris, Brussels, and Berlin.
– Grand Central starts  operating passenger services between  Newcastle upon Tyne and Brighton.
– New Stadler FLIRT electric and battery-electric trains enter service.
– FGC takes over operation of lines RL3 and RL4 of the Lleida commuter railway service with new Stadler FLIRT trainsets.

On March 26, 2026, the European Sleeper will begin a night train service connecting Paris, Brussels, and Berlin. Additionally, Grand Central will start operating passenger services between Newcastle upon Tyne and Brighton. 

FINAL: European Sleeper begins a night train service between Paris, Brussels, and Berlin.

final_answer: European Sleeper begins a night train service between Paris, Brussels, and Berlin.
